notes.title: The Summer of Pride Steam Sale is here!!!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

In case you haven't heard, we're participating in the first ever Summer of Pride Steam Sale, with both A Normal Lost Phone and Another Lost Phone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30377638/6ad9eead29dfd145eae686f677439805f990ed7a.png


Click below if you'd like to check out great deals and discounts on a bunch of amazingly inclusive LGBTQIA+ games!

Summer of Pride 2020

notes.title: Changelog version 1.4
notes.content:
This update fixes some minor bugs, and improves the localizations in most languages.

By the way, have you tried our other game, "A Normal Lost Phone"? You might enjoy it if you liked this one!
